QuestInfo.name: The Lost Permit 2
QuestInfo.0: 10 Boogies seems to have brightened up. See what's on her mind.
QuestInfo.1:
She said you should check all the paths you've seen so far. Great.

Press the hotkey W to open up the World Map UI, search for Tiguru's Forest in the World Map UI, add it to Navigation, and then go there.
QuestInfo.2: You have arrived at #m130010210#, just like 10 Boogies asked.

0.0: Oh, wait! I remember. I dropped my bag in Tiguru's Forest when I was tying my shoe. Go get it back! Hurry, hurry!

yes.0: Find Tiguru's Forest on your World Map and go take a look!

no.0: I just know it's there! You gotta go. I really like that bag!

yes.0: This is not working out like I wanted it to.

npc.0: Use the World Map like you did earlier, and come find me in Tiguru's Forest.
